name: Air traffic controller
hook: Gives information and instructions to airline pilots.

name: Merchant Navy deck officer
hook: Responsible for the safety, navigation, operation and crew of cargo and passenger ships.

name: Live sound engineer
hook: Controls the sound at events like theatre performances, music concerts and festivals.

name: Tree surgeon
hook: Works in towns and the countryside, assessing tree health and felling unsafe trees.

name: Archaeologist
hook: Learns about the past by studying written records, collecting oral histories and excavating remains.

name: Countryside ranger
hook: Helps protect the environment and support wildlife by looking after forests, coastlines, wetlands and parks.

name: Marine biologist
hook: Studies organisms and ecosystems in the oceans and other saltwater environments.
pay: Entry-level pay runs from about £12,000 to £30,000 depending on the role, and senior roles reach around £45,000

name: Farrier
pay: Pay varies, and the page gives no range
